written.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models disprove Exponential Time Hypothesis
written.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic stated that their AI models disproved the 27-year-old Exponential Time Hypothesis, upending research based on the premise that certain problems require exponential time to solve. Both firms published their proofs on GitHub in natural language and the machine-checkable Lean format.

written.headline: Anthropic details agent memory architecture and dreaming capability
written.summary: Anthropic published research on agent memory systems inspired by human cognition, introducing a 'dreaming' process that allows Claude models to reorganize memory using session transcripts during idle time. The feature runs asynchronously to process between one and 100 session transcripts without altering model weights.

written.headline: AI-boosted attacks are disrupting the cybersecurity industry
written.summary: Artificial intelligence is driving a wave of cyberattacks and data breaches as private and state actors use AI to detect and exploit system vulnerabilities. Alex Stamos, chief security officer at Cognition, discussed the disruption on The Verge's Decoder podcast.
